_labelling: Labelled by one person (the kit author) BEFORE any retriever existed; committed in its own commit. Rule: a pattern is relevant iff an implementer of the fragment must solve the problem in that pattern's `solves` field; topical mention alone does not count. dev = may be used to tune the retriever; held = never looked at while tuning.

fragments.text: Invoice totals are kept in paise as whole numbers; GST at 18% is applied per line and rounded to the nearest paisa, ties to even.
The settings file must survive the laptop losing power halfway through saving; on next launch the app opens either the previous or the new settings, never a garbled file.
Stock movements are never edited. If a delivery was keyed wrong, staff post a correcting movement that points at the original; on-hand quantity is the sum of movements.
Each wholesaler customer sees only their own orders, even if a query forgets to filter.
The chorus returns after every verse; the bridge modulates up a whole tone.
Shop owners upload last month's price list from Excel; show them which rows are new, which repeat an existing SKU, and which are broken, before anything is saved.
The tool prints the report and exits 0; bad arguments exit 2; tests run with a frozen 'today' date.
Regulators may ask us to prove that no past weighbridge reading was altered after the fact.
Delivery drivers record drop-offs in basements with no signal; the records go up when they're back in coverage, without duplicates.
The payment provider's key must not appear in the repository; the service refuses to start if it's missing.
Each lecture is 50 minutes; slides carry speaker notes; every learning objective is assessed by at least one quiz question.
Split a ₹1,000 catering bill three ways so the shares add back to exactly the bill.
The journal export is rewritten in place each night; a crash during the rewrite must not leave a half file that the morning job then reads.
Add a discount_code column to orders; two developers are adding columns on separate branches this week.
Loyalty points are earned and spent; a mistaken award is cancelled by a counter-entry, and the history shows both.
Write chapter 3, in which the narrator's sister, introduced in chapter 1 as Meera, returns.
